children: Peter Warren Automotive keeps its bull at Ord Minnett despite the Australian vehicle retailer's weak trading update. ASX-listed Peter Warren expects lower margins and higher financing costs to pull it to an underlying first-half loss, and Ord Minnett analyst Phillip Chippindale acknowledges that the retailer is operating against a very challenging backdrop. Competition from new market entrants and cost-of-living pressures on consumers are making things hard, he says. Ord Minnett slashes its target price by 42% to 0.64 Australian dollars but maintains a buy rating on valuation. Shares are up 6.7% at A$0.56. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
